title: UK Athletics and the Home Country Athletics Federations: Adult Safeguarding Policy 2023 and Safeguarding Regulations
claims: The policy sets out national and club-level roles and responsibilities, including a Lead Safeguarding Officer and Club Welfare Officer; it does not use a regional or regional-tier structure.

Appendix 1 routes safeguarding referrals to the Club Welfare Officer or UK Athletics and to police and local authorities, with disciplinary procedures; detailed assessment steps sit in separately referenced procedures.

The policy expects clubs to have accessible reporting routes for concerns about adults at risk; it is an adult-specific policy and does not state that clubs must handle child and adult concerns under the same route.

verification.note: UKA 2023 成人保障政策 PDF 全文；2026-11-20 逐条收窄到原文层级与附录 1 的实际表述。

claimVerification.note: 全文列国家级（Lead Safeguarding Officer）与俱乐部级（CWO）职责；无 regional/region 层级。
附录 1 有 CWO/UKA 上报、与警方和地方当局合作、纪律程序；“评估”细节在另行引用的程序文件中，不在本政策正文。
附录 1 写俱乐部上报通道；本文件是成人专项政策，未写俱乐部应同时按同一通道处理儿童与成人问题。
